CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_market_risk(
    p_flow bigint,
    p_rate numeric,
    p_score numeric,
    p_count integer,
    p_lifespan integer
) RETURNS numeric AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Risk formula: combines flow, rate, score, count, and lifespan
    -- Higher risk when: low escrow rate, low interaction score, high vendor count relative to buyers, short lifespan
    RETURN ROUND((p_flow * (100 - p_rate) * (100 - p_score)) / 
                 NULLIF(p_count * p_lifespan, 0), 2);
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
